maturity.label: 逐指標檢查證據，尚非策略通過
maturity.reason: 僅達估計 SE 的最低樣本要求；各指標須通過週報 §⑨ 的分級 t 門檻，再依 WEEKLY_REVIEW 的連續週數與成本條件判斷。

method.factor_aggregation: equal-weight group IC then equal-weight dates
method.tier_aggregation: equal-weight stocks within date then equal-weight dates
method.net_benchmark: leave-one-out group median, before benchmark costs
method.net_caveat: hypothetical overlapping fixed-horizon cohorts, no slippage/capacity/portfolio accounting
method.ablation: retrospective paired date/group unsmoothed rounded composite; not new-strategy OOS
method.effective_observations: repo heuristic n_days/horizon, not empirically measured independence
method.returns: current adjusted outcomes; signals and membership are frozen as-seen
